title: The section-normalized natural restriction on completed integral point modules
statement: Let D be the finite-field datum of [def-trf-scheme-frobenius], with algebraic closure k, and let l be prime and E a finite-dimensional field extension of Q_l as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Let F be pointIntegralSections with its canonical integral scalar action [def-weil-point-section-scalar-functors], on the completed-coefficient module category [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] over Spec k. For every natural number r, let P_r be the recorded completed-module inverse-image functor for the r-th power of point Frobenius [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], and rho_r the actual point-site restriction arrow [lem-trf-point-transport-composition]. There is a unique natural transformation sigma:F→P_r⋙F whose component on every module M sends each section x over the final object to M(rho_r)(x). The components are linear for the actual completed coefficient action. No constructibility or completeness hypothesis on M, or condition l≠char(k), is imposed.

source.place: (1.1.3), p. 150 and (1.1.7), pp. 150–151; the explicit pro-etale/completed-coefficient scalar-normalization argument of lem-weil-point-automorphism-restriction-natural, extracted for prerequisite steps 1–3 of lem-trf-integral-point-transport-tower-powers. This formulation is an agent extraction, not a theorem asserted verbatim by Deligne.

proof.text: The universe-normalized constant-to-completion coefficient map equals the original map: after every limit projection both are the same quotient map. The canonical site restriction arrow equals pointPowerRestriction by faithfulness of the forgetful functor. Apply the existing scalar-normalization square, then cancel the inverse completed coefficient isomorphism. This proves that section restriction is linear for the required transported action. Additivity is inherited from the module restriction map.

Use these linear maps as the components of sigma. Naturality is precisely PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply for the actual site restriction arrow. The construction gives the displayed formula on every section. For any second transformation with this formula, natural-transformation extensionality and linear-map extensionality identify every component. At r=0 the same argument applies to the identity power, and for the zero module it is the unique zero map.

proof_origin.place: Factorization of the already proved scalar-restriction construction and its ordinary naturality from the item into a separate compiled module. Every helper and the public theorem is proved; no hole is moved or added.

lean.statement:
theorem existsUnique (r : ℕ) :
    ∃! sigma : pointIntegralSections l E D.k ⟶
        inverseImageIntegralModules l E ((pointFrobeniusAut D) ^ r).hom ⋙
          pointIntegralSections l E D.k,
      ∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E (Spec (.of D.k)))
        (x : M.val.obj (op (ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of D.k)))))),
        sigma.app M x = M.val.map (pointPowerRestriction D r).op x
